subject: Renewal paperwork: term alignment + capacity uplift — redline coordination
messages:
From: Ravi Malhotra <ravi@stratix.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dana Cho <dana.cho@stratix.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion: draft and asks

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the renewal pricing we discussed last week. We're excited to move forward but have three quick asks before our procurement team will sign:

1) Term alignment — can we move to an 18-month term (instead of 12) to match our budget cycle?
2) Capacity uplift — we want to add a 30% burst pool for Q3/Q4 (peaked usage expected).
3) Order of operations — procurement needs the MSA + order form in one package for redlines (they prefer Word).

I've attached the draft renewal (Stratix_Renewal_Draft_v3.docx) with our preferred clause language for retention and indemnity called out. Could you loop in legal and let me know the earliest we can get a redline?

Appreciate it — target signature is 2028-06-22 to preserve the current rate card.

Best,
Ravi
Director, Cloud Infrastructure
Stratix AI

[Attachment: Stratix_Renewal_Draft_v3.docx (docx)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ravi Malhotra <ravi@stratix.ai>
Cc: Dana Cho <dana.cho@stratix.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: draft and asks

Thanks Ravi — looping in Lauren (sales lead) and Monica (CS) + legal next.

Quick notes from our side:
- 18-month term: plausible, will need a short internal approval (sales + finance).
- 30% burst pool: sounds fine; need to confirm exact burst window and billing mechanics (overage vs committed burst bucket). Monica, can you confirm technical feasibility and recommended billing approach?
- We'll assemble the MSA + order form in a single Word package for your procurement.

I'll follow up once legal has redlined. Targeting an internal turnaround by end of day Wed.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Inline: Acknowledged — will coordinate contract packet]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ravi Malhotra <ravi@stratix.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: draft and asks

Aditya / Lauren — technical confirmation: adding a 30% burst pool is feasible. Two operational details:

1) Burst window: recommend defining as a monthly peak bucket usable across projects; set clear throttles to avoid preempting committed capacity.
2) Billing: easiest to model as a reserved baseline + burst allowance billed at a blended incremental price; if procurement prefers overage billing we'll provide a 30-day lookback and cap opt-in.

I'll prepare the suggested contract language for the order form (billing table + exhibit) and send to legal by EOD Wednesday.

Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Stratix_OrderForm_2028Q3.pdf (pdf) — billing tables incl. baseline + burst rows]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ravi Malhotra <ravi@stratix.ai>, Dana Cho <dana.cho@stratix.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: draft and asks — redlines attached

Team / Ravi,

I've reviewed Stratix_Renewal_Draft_v3 and the OrderForm. Key redlines (high-level):

- Term/Auto-Renewal: Accept 18-month term; change auto-renew to 12-month subsequent terms unless both parties agree otherwise. Add a 60-day written notice window for non-renewal.
- Burst definitions: Convert your suggested "burst pool" language into Exhibit B (Capacity Addendum) with clear definitions for "baseline committed units", "burst allowance", and "billing trigger". This avoids ambiguity and keeps the MSA compact.
- Data retention: Marked your proposed retention period as acceptable but added clarifying language about backup snapshots and export obligations on contract termination.
- Indemnity/Cap: Pushed back on unlimited liability language; proposed a carve-out for willful misconduct and a capped liability equal to the last 12 months of fees (standard).
- Procurements/Signatures: Provided a combined redline in Word so procurement can track.

See attached: redline_exhibitB.docx (our proposed exhibit), and the combined MSA+OrderForm packet returned as Word with tracked changes. Please review and confirm priorities; I'll incorporate any non-legal commercial asks from Sales.

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Legal & Compliance

[Attachments: redline_exhibitB.docx (docx), Renewal_MSA_OrderForm_Aditya_v1_redline.docx (docx)]

From: Ravi Malhotra <ravi@stratix.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dana Cho <dana.cho@stratix.ai>, Eli Records <eli@stratix.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Jun 2028 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: draft and asks — redlines attached

Markus — thanks for the quick review and concrete language. We appreciate the Exhibit approach for burst; that should satisfy procurement. A few follow-ups from our side:

- Liability cap: procurement will ask whether we can carve out a somewhat higher cap for data privacy incidents. Is there flexibility to tie that to insurance limits?
- Billing trigger: can you confirm the billing trigger will be a daily aggregated check with a 72-hour soft buffer before charges apply? We want a brief buffer for operational spikes.
- Signature packet: can you send the Word package with tracked changes back to procurement (cc'ing dana.cho@stratix.ai) so they can mark up locally?

If we can resolve the 72-hour buffer and the liability carve-out by next Tue (2028-06-13), we can keep to our 2028-06-22 signature goal.

Thanks — looping Eli (procurement) for any redline preferences.

Best,
Ravi
